"""Run the compiler on a request, then verify the response independently."""
import json, subprocess, sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from verify import verify

def run(payload):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                     capture_output=True)
    if p.returncode: raise SystemExit("child failed: "+p.stderr.decode()[:600])
    if p.stderr: print("stderr:", p.stderr.decode()[:400])
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())

if __name__=="__main__":
    data=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()
    req=json.loads(data.decode())
    out=run(data)
    if "error" in out:
        print("ERROR RESPONSE:", out); raise SystemExit(1)
    verify(req,out,out)
    print("VERIFIED", json.dumps([c["objective"] for c in out["cases"]]))
EOF
